title: Forcing Conjecture for Bipartite Cyclic Graphs
exact_target: A graph $H$ is forcing if its expected homomorphism density together with edge density forces quasirandomness of a graph sequence. Are the forcing graphs exactly the bipartite graphs containing a cycle?
